nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.prediction: Favors fast starts — a new routine, a first attempt, a quick decision that pays off. Physical energy runs high, so use it before it turns restless.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.prediction: A period of creative intensity and letting go of something that's run its course. What feels like an ending is really clearing space for the next thing.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.prediction: Sharp clarity arrives — you'll see exactly what needs cutting away. Good window for honest conversations and decisive action, less so for patience.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.prediction: Growth-oriented and sensory — money, comfort, and relationships all get easier to build. A good stretch for anything that needs steady nurturing.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.prediction: Restless curiosity takes over; you'll want to search, explore, or start researching something new. Follow it, but avoid committing until the picture is clearer.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.prediction: Expect a bit of upheaval — old structures loosen so something more honest can take their place. Uncomfortable in the moment, clarifying in hindsight.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.prediction: A return or renewal theme — reconnecting with a person, place, or plan you'd set aside. Optimism is well-supported this period.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.prediction: One of the steadier windows — good for routines, commitments, and anything that needs consistency rather than excitement.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.prediction: Intuition runs sharp; trust what you're sensing beneath the surface of a situation. Not the best window for taking things at face value.

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.prediction: Themes of legacy, authority, and ancestry surface. A good period for honoring where you come from while deciding what to carry forward.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.prediction: Leans toward rest, pleasure, and creative play. Give yourself permission to enjoy something without justifying it.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.prediction: Favors partnership and follow-through — agreements made now tend to hold. Good window for formalizing something you've been circling.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.prediction: Skilled, hands-on energy — a strong period for craft, precision work, or finishing something that needs a careful touch.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.prediction: Design and presentation matter more than usual. Good window for anything visual, structural, or image-related.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.prediction: Independence and flexibility are favored — plans that require bending with circumstances go more smoothly than rigid ones.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.prediction: Determined, goal-driven energy. Good for pushing a long-term plan forward, less suited to starting something entirely new.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.prediction: Friendship, loyalty, and devotion take center stage. A good period for deepening existing bonds rather than forming new ones.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.prediction: Leadership and protection themes — you may find yourself stepping up for someone or something. Handle authority carefully this period.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.prediction: An uprooting, get-to-the-bottom-of-it energy. Good for investigating and closing loops, not for starting anything fragile.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.prediction: Early-stage confidence and momentum — good for the opening move of something ambitious, even before all details are settled.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.prediction: Favors lasting achievement over quick wins. What you build carefully now tends to hold up well over time.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.prediction: A listening, learning period — conversations, study, and absorbing new information all go well. Less suited to broadcasting your own opinions.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.prediction: Rhythmic, prosperous energy tied to music, groups, and material gain. Good window for collaborative projects with momentum.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.prediction: Healing and hidden-truth themes — good for research, therapy, or quietly working through something private.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.prediction: Intense, transformative energy. Big realizations are more likely now than small, comfortable ones.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.prediction: A deep, slow-moving period well suited to reflection, rest, or spiritual practice rather than fast action.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.prediction: A completion and transition theme — wrapping up one chapter gently before the next one properly begins.
